description: This file contains functions for managing deferred revenue and expense accounting in ERPNext, including validation, condition building, conversion of deferred amounts, booking dates calculation, amount calculations, GL entries creation, and error handling.

methods.name: validate_service_stop_date
methods.description: Validates that service stop dates are within start and end dates for invoice items.

methods.name: build_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for deferred revenue/expense based on process type, account, and company.

methods.name: convert_deferred_expense_to_expense
methods.description: Books deferred expenses into actual expenses for a given process within a date range.

methods.name: convert_deferred_revenue_to_income
methods.description: Books deferred revenue into income for a given process within a date range.

methods.name: get_booking_dates
methods.description: Calculates start and end booking dates for deferred revenue/expense based on previous GL or journal entries.

methods.name: calculate_monthly_amount
methods.description: Calculates monthly amount for deferred revenue/expense based on service duration and booking period.

methods.name: calculate_amount
methods.description: Calculates amount for deferred revenue/expense based on total days and booking days.

methods.name: get_already_booked_amount
methods.description: Retrieves total already booked amount from GL entries and journal entries for a specific invoice item.

methods.name: book_deferred_income_or_expense
methods.description: Books deferred income or expense into GL entries or journal entries based on configuration.

methods.name: process_deferred_accounting
methods.description: Automates conversion of deferred income/expense into actual income/expense at month end.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for deferred income/expense, handling errors and database transactions.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Sends email notification if deferred accounting processing encounters errors.

methods.name: book_revenue_via_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates journal entries to defer or recognize revenue/expense.

methods.name: get_deferred_booking_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves appropriate deferred revenue or expense accounts for a given invoice item.
